summary: Manulife Financial Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, reporting the voting results of its annual meeting of common shareholders. The filing discloses the election of 13 director nominees, the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all approved by substantial majorities. This is a routine report of shareholder voting results on standard governance matters. The filing does not involve any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic changes disclosed. This is a regulatory formality for a foreign private issuer.
